name: WPTV News - FL Palm Beaches and Treasure Coast

episodes.title: Behind the scenes: The making of 'GROOMED: Surviving Epstein'
episodes.description: WPTV Chief Investigative Reporter Jamie Ostroff and WPTV Anchor Ashley Glass discuss what was learned in the making of 'GROOMED: Surviving Epstein'.

episodes.title: Trauma therapist wants to make one thing clear about Epstein victims
episodes.description: Randee Kogan worked with Palm Beach County Victim Services as a licensed therapist around 2007 and 2008. That's when she first met and worked with Epstein's accusers.

episodes.title: Former investigative reporter for the Palm Beach Post reflects on Epstein case
episodes.description: Holly Baltz covered Epstein's case extensively since 2008 and was part of the Palm Beach Post's successful legal effort to obtain transcripts from his grand jury proceedings following his 2006 arrest.

episodes.title: GROOMED: Surviving Epstein
episodes.description: A team of journalists at WPTV is reflecting on 20 years since the story of the late Jeffrey Epstein first broke. Survivors share their stories while others unpack the effects of Epstein's abuse.

episodes.title: 'GROOMED: Surviving Epstein' airs Thursday, July 22 on WPTV
episodes.description: Watch 'GROOMED: Surviving Epstein' tomorrow on WPTV.

episodes.title: 'NOT THEIR FAULT': Trauma therapist speaks out for Epstein survivors
episodes.description: WPTV's original documentary "GROOMED: Surviving Epstein," airs Thursday, July 23 at 7 p.m. ET

episodes.title: Florida woman opens up about Epstein abuse in WPTV's 'GROOMED: Surviving Epstein'
episodes.description: 20 years after the late Palm Beach financier Jeffrey Epstein first faced criminal charges for the sexual exploitation of young girls, a team of journalists at WPTV continues to examine his impact.

episodes.title: BREAKING HER SILENCE: Epstein survivor to share her story in WPTV documentary
episodes.description: GROOMED: Surviving Epstein will air on Thursday, July 23 at 7 p.m. on WPTV.

episodes.title: Epstein survivors testify at Palm Beach County hearing
episodes.description: Survivors of Jeffrey Epstein's abuse gathered in Palm Beach County on Tuesday for a "shadow hearing" with Democrats on the House Oversight Committee.
